scope: Compare current runtime/player_journal timing integration with exact frozen323 policy; inspect new runtime/journal fixture additions. Collector complete robustness and frame hooks are reviewed separately.

reviewed_behavior.assessment: A.present and A.refresh wrappers still call original bodies directly and retain no-value returns; no new protected-call boundary surrounds yieldable decision execution. Original coroutine resume and stale publication checks remain. Coroutine errors retain safe existing cleanup and now get an explicit error timing receipt.

Invalidation and new public-key paths clear worker/completed receipt fields. Completed advice timing attaches only with current captured public fingerprint, matching game instance and exact last_decision_result==A.result. Timing remains separate from policy snapshots and fingerprints.

Collector now() checks existing opt-in before reading the clock; disabled journal exits before clock/performance/capture/append. Journal catches injected clock/measurement errors and emits explicit unavailable monotonic status without failing an otherwise valid event. Runtime depends on its owned collector methods remaining safe; separate collector review is required.

Added advice timing is a scalar collector receipt, not a card or hidden-RNG snapshot. Compact J:timing passes explicit empty context and avoids full observe. Existing public_snapshot redaction, callback linkage, archive encoder/append handling and settled scheduling remain unchanged.

Read fixtures for separated drag elapsed/active resume time, exact completed counts, result reuse, stale receipt exclusion, cancellation/error records, synchronous completion and disabled state clearing. Journal fixtures cover disabled work, precise anchors, invalid/backward clock, failed metrics, compact context, failed append and idle capture counts.

findings.title: Synchronous decision exceptions do not create an error timing receipt
findings.detail: The synchronous A.decision.run/A.present path is unchanged in propagating errors, but those errors bypass resume_finished and finish_decision. The new error receipt currently exists only for coroutine-resume failures. This preserves prior policy/error behavior but means diagnostic error coverage is incomplete for blind/pack/round synchronous failures. Document the limit or add a separately tested catch-and-rethrow mechanism that preserves original error objects/behavior; do not wrap yieldable paths casually.
